audience: Children under three, especially a two-year-old learning to repeat simple clear English
style: Original high-quality preschool 2D character animation, clean warm-dark-brown outlines, soft hand-painted storybook backgrounds, restrained pastel palette of rose pink, dusty teal, sage, warm cream and pale sky blue, moderate contrast and soft warm daylight. Keep Alice's pink recognizable but less glaring than the reference; no fluorescent or aggressively saturated colors.
